name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
summary: Financial assistance for construction of pucca houses with basic amenities for eligible rural households that are houseless or living in kutcha/dilapidated houses.

eligibility_clauses.text: The household must be a rural household without a pucca house (houseless or kutcha house).
The household must not own a pucca house in any part of the country.
The household must be included in the SECC 2011 housing deprivation list (or verified by the Gram Sabha).

entitlement_rules.text: In plain areas, assistance is Rs. 1,20,000 per unit for house construction.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First-level verification and grievance redressal at the block.
Escalation to the district rural development agency.
